entries.title: Psalms 67:1
segments:
. A prayer that, by God's blessing on His people, His salvation and praise may be extended over the earth.

segments:

segments: 3-5. Thanks will be rendered for the blessings of His wise and holy government (compare

entries.title: Psalms 67:6
segments: 6, 7. The blessings of a fruitful harvest are mentioned as types of greater and spiritual blessings, under which all nations shall fear and love God.
